item: harrow deck (53 cards; function as darts when thrown by a harrowkin)
markdown:
The most powerful harrowkin are living embodiments of harrow cards. **[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 38 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 36 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 33 [Fabled Harrowkin](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2581) **Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 83 **Perception** +29; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=12) **Languages** [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1) **Skills** [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) +30, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +32, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +32, [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) +29 **Str** +7 **Dex** +5 **Con** +7 **Int** +2 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +9 **Harrowkin Suit** any
**Read the Cards** **Items** _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24)_, [_harrow deck_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=824) (53 cards; function as [darts](/Weapons.aspx?ID=68) when thrown by a harrowkin) --- **AC** 40 **Fort** +32 **Ref** +30 **Will** +27 **HP** 315 **Immunities** [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=40) effects, [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46), [doomed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=9), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10), [fatigued](/Conditions.aspx?ID=15), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=89), [misfortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=110), [necromancy](/Traits.aspx?ID=117), [nonlethal](/Traits.aspx?ID=188) attacks, [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) **Defensive Suit**
**Twist Fate** ([divination](/Traits.aspx?ID=47), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76), [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120)) **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** A creature critically hits the harrowkin; **Effect** The harrowkin manipulates fortune in their favor. The triggering attack becomes a regular hit. --- **Speed** 25 feet, fly 40 feet **Melee** _greatsword_ +32 ([Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [versatile P](/Traits.aspx?ID=200)), **Damage** 3d12+15 slashing **Ranged** _harrow card_ +30 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [Magical](/Traits.aspx?ID=103), [range increment 20 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=248), [Thrown](/Traits.aspx?ID=195)), **Damage** 3d6+15 piercing **Occult Innate Spells** DC 35, +27 - **Cantrips (8th)** [Daze](/Spells.aspx?ID=61), [Detect Magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=66), [Ghost Sound](/Spells.aspx?ID=132), [Telekinetic Projectile](/Spells.aspx?ID=334) - **1st** [Ill Omen](/Spells.aspx?ID=696) (at will) - **2nd** [Augury](/Spells.aspx?ID=15) - **4th** [Confusion](/Spells.aspx?ID=48) - **5th** [Dimension Door](/Spells.aspx?ID=69) - **7th** [Visions of Danger](/Spells.aspx?ID=358) - **8th** [Uncontrollable Dance](/Spells.aspx?ID=347) **Shuffle the Deck**
